tasks.short: Report pertinent safeguarding information to the proper authority.

steps.what: Gather the concern and relevant factual observations
Determine urgency and the appropriate reporting route
Prepare the factual safeguarding report
Check the completed report and actual authority contact
Report the accepted facts directly to the safeguarding authority
Write and check the report outcome and follow-up instructions
Commit the accepted entry to the restricted safeguarding record

tasks.design: First test native safeguarding forms in the restricted case system in {OTHER}; reuse verified identity fields while the psychologist writes the actual concerns. The psychologist checks the completed report and contacts the authority directly, then records the outcome for a separate checked commit; urgent reporting never waits for automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safeguarding facts are sensitive, contextual and must be distinguished from inference.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing forms can reuse identity and case references without generating allegations.
tasks.still_hard: Urgency, disclosure scope and the right authority remain professional judgements under local protocols.
tasks.human_edge: Act promptly on a concern and communicate uncertainty without minimising risk.
tasks.altitude: A little less rekeying; reporting judgement and responsibility remain with the psychologist.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a restricted form can reuse checked identity fields while safeguarding assessment and direct reporting remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes factual report preparation, authority contact and outcome recording. This is a non-immediate administrative sequence; an urgent threat uses the direct emergency route immediately and later records the facts. No form completion delays that route.

Provisional shares are not measured baselines. Only verified identity/case-field reuse shortens s3; all allegation description and uncertainty wording remain human. Existing one-click commits earn no added saving.

Pupil administration produces pupil_id, name, contact and case_reference. s1 verifies identity; missing or unsafe-to-reuse fields are entered manually in s3. s2 uses the organisation's current safeguarding protocol and named authority contacts, maintained by its safeguarding lead.
s4 checks the final report facts, disclosure scope and actual contact before s5. Unexpected questions are answered by the psychologist's live judgement and do not trigger any autonomous send.

s6 manually captures authority_contact, contact_time, facts_disclosed, reference and follow_up, then checks the final entry before s7. Changed entry or destination invalidates a2. Access and consultation requirements are included in rollout.
unknowns: Applicable national reporting route and school protocol
research_questions: Can the configured form prevent wrong-pupil reuse without delaying urgent reporting?

already_counted.description: Check reused identity and disclosure facts within s4

incremental.description: Check form mappings and authority contact configuration

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted factual report and verified authority contact; scope changes require live professional reassessment
s6 accepted safeguarding case entry and restricted case destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 4 identity-rekeying and 5 filing hours minus 1 upkeep = 8. Low has half the identity reuse and manual filing: 2 minus 1 = 1. Concern assessment and authority contact retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret test results and prepare psychological reports for school staff and parents.

steps.what: Check test provenance, scoring version and contextual evidence
Populate factual test-result tables in the report
Interpret the results, validity and limits
Write the explanatory report from the psychologist's interpretation

loop.input: Psychologist's interpretation, verified result tables and intended recipient group
loop.output: Report prose preserving uncertainty and linking each assertion to an approved interpretation or test result
loop.check: Psychologist checks every inference, qualification and recommendation against source interpretation within s4, then checks the complete revised report in s5
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported interpretation is removed and complex sections written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Test a report template first. The residual work is explanatory prose with case-specific qualifications, not table assembly; a template cannot express that meaning alone.

steps.what: Approve the final report and disclosure audience
Release the accepted report to the authorised recipients

tasks.design: Use native report tables from the assessment system in {OTHER}, then let a bounded drafting step in {DOCS} express the psychologist's own interpretation. Keep validity and diagnosis judgements human; only the completed, substantively checked report and recipient snapshot can pass the separate release gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report prose combines numerical evidence with qualified professional conclusions.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates handle factual tables while bounded source-linked drafting can assist explanatory writing.
tasks.still_hard: Invalid tests, contradictory evidence and diagnosis remain professional responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the test cannot establish and avoid an unjustified label.

ambition.what: Offer a parent-readable explanation of the same approved findings alongside the professional report.

tasks.altitude: Less table copying and prose rewriting; assessment and disclosure authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain approved assessment findings in accessible language
reach.learn: Psychometric uncertainty and boundaries on sharing test material

evidence.claim: The digest reports a child mental-health documentation pilot; it supports the plausibility of assisted notes, not these school-report savings or diagnostic validity.
Model knowledge: source-linked report drafting requires substantive checks of the psychologist's interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is report interpretation, preparation and release; test administration and eligibility decisions are separate. Provisional shares must be measured before use as a business case.

The assessment administrator supplies pupil_id, instrument, edition, date, raw_score, norm_score, norm_version and validity_notes. s1 checks these against source reports; missing fields are resolved manually there. No model invents a score or norm.
s3 includes capture of conclusion, supporting_evidence, limitation and recommendation at full effort. These are the sole sources for s4's inferences, never a model-generated diagnosis.

Pupil administration maintains recipient_id, disclosure_scope and expiry; s5 checks the current permission record. Native exports and templates precede custom code; already automatic tables earn no saving.

s5 occurs after the last revision. Changes to prose, interpretation, pupil identity or audience invalidate a1. Record retention remains governed by school policy; no unsupported legal dates are assumed.
unknowns: Assessment export access and test licensing restrictions
research_questions: Does blinded review detect lost uncertainty and changed diagnostic implications in drafted reports?

already_counted.description: Read and correct generated report meaning in s4
Final report and audience check within s5

incremental.description: Audit omissions and maintain report templates and field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 final psychological report version and authorised recipient snapshot; edits revoke approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 table assembly + 10 writing + 5 release hours minus 2 upkeep = 28. Low uses half the table/writing benefit and manual release: 7.5+5-2 = 10.5. Professional interpretation retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain confidential pupil, service and behavioural records.

steps.what: Verify pupil identity, record category and source documents
Write the service and behaviour narrative

loop.input: Psychologist's short dictated account of the completed service and observed behaviour
loop.output: Draft service note preserving speaker attribution, observed facts and uncertainty
loop.check: Psychologist checks facts, negation, attribution and omissions against their dictated account within s2; final record review is s4
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; ambiguous audio goes to manual writing, never guessed text
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native typed forms and ordinary dictation first. Only organising free speech into narrative headings justifies a bounded model; structured service facts require no model.

steps.what: Index the record and attachments under the chosen record category
Check the final package, pupil match and access restrictions
Maintain student records by committing the checked service and behavioural package

tasks.design: Test native restricted-record forms and dictation in the pupil case system in {OTHER} first. Where narrative writing remains substantial, organise the psychologist's own dictated account into a draft, then assemble attachments by explicit identifiers; a person checks the entire final package before its separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative notes and confidential reports require careful matching to the right pupil and access group.
tasks.enabler_now: Speech-assisted notes and native record indexing can reduce typing and attachment navigation.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible note can misattribute behaviour or omit a crucial qualification.
tasks.human_edge: Separate observed behaviour from professional interpretation and protect unnecessary disclosure.

ambition.what: Provide a source-linked service chronology with each attachment tied to its original report.

tasks.altitude: Less typing and indexing; the psychologist retains responsibility for factual accuracy and access.

reach.task: Maintain an accurate restricted service chronology
reach.learn: Factual observation, record categories and access boundaries

evidence.claim: The digest reports speech-driven reporting in Dutch mental-health care; applicability to school pupil records remains untested.
Model knowledge: explicit pupil and record identifiers support deterministic attachment indexing.

assumptions: Boundary is maintenance of existing service and behaviour records, not counselling or original special-education report writing. Shares describe a provisional manual-writing/indexing case, not a measured school baseline.

s1 produces pupil_id, service_date, service_type, record_category, attachment_ids and permitted_access_group. Psychologist checks identity and source documents; absent or conflicting metadata is resolved manually at full time.

Future dictation in s2 is by the psychologist after the service, not ambient recording of pupils. Its 18 remaining hours include dictation, correction, substantive review and fallback. No free structured-input producer is assumed.
s3 uses the s1 selected category, never automated psychological classification. Existing approved reports are referenced, not rewritten or given a second approval for their original creation.
s4 checks the completed narrative plus attachments and exact access group after assembly. Any change voids a1. If native indexing/commit is already automatic, remove those baseline savings.
unknowns: Existing record entry and attachment workflow
How much narrative is already structured
research_questions: Does note review catch negation and speaker errors without exceeding the retained writing budget?

already_counted.description: Dictation, narrative correction and draft review in s2
Package identity and access checks within s4

incremental.description: Audit note omissions and maintain record-category mappings
Maintain secure dictation processing and record permissions

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted pupil record package version, pupil_id and permitted access group

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 12 writing + 15 indexing + 15 commit hours minus 2 upkeep = 40. Low has half the writing and indexing benefits, with commit still manual: 6+7.5-2 = 11.5. All fact capture and final checks remain priced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Combine test and informant evidence to diagnose and assess special-service eligibility.

steps.what: Obtain and verify student test and informant evidence
Compile source results and dated observations into an evidence pack
Clarify contradictory information with teachers and parents
Formulate and test the diagnostic interpretation
Assess the evidence against special-service eligibility criteria
Write and check the diagnostic and eligibility reasoning note
Commit the checked reasoning note to the assessment case

tasks.design: Configure an evidence pack in the assessment case system in {OTHER} that preserves source documents, dates and test versions without interpreting them. The psychologist retains clarification, diagnosis and eligibility reasoning, then checks a separately written reasoning note before its gated case-record commit; external eligibility notification is a later workflow.
tasks.previous_blocker: Multi-source evidence is scattered and contradictions cannot be resolved by aggregation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and document indexing can assemble known source artefacts without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosis and eligibility depend on validity, context and applicable service criteria.
tasks.human_edge: Weigh conflicting evidence and explain the limits of an eligibility recommendation.

ambition.what: Provide an assessment evidence pack that shows the provenance and date of each source.

tasks.altitude: Less pack assembly, with all assessment rights and accountability unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare an assessment source chronology without interpreting scores
reach.learn: Evidence provenance, test versions and confidential record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic document assembly can preserve source evidence; it cannot diagnose conditions or decide service eligibility.

assumptions: Boundary includes source verification, clarification, diagnostic and eligibility assessment and its reasoning record. Formal service allocation and external notification are separate, with no savings or transferred effort claimed. Shares are provisional.

Test administrators, teachers and parents produce the original source documents. s1 verifies pupil_id, source_id, source_role, observation_date, instrument_version and attachment_id; missing metadata is manually captured there. No theme coding or interpretation is assumed pre-existing.

s2 copies references and existing test tables only, retaining original source text. Contradictions are not automatically reconciled; s3 includes manual capture of clarification_text, informant and date at full effort.
Applicable service criteria are versioned by the responsible service authority. s5 manually assesses them without automatic ranking or inferred eligibility.

s6 writes and checks the actual final reasoning note before s7; any revision or pupil/case change invalidates a1. Native pack configuration precedes code, and already automatic assembly earns no saving.
research_questions: Can the evidence pack preserve contradictory observations without presenting a false consensus?

already_counted.description: Verify pack source links while clarifying evidence in s3
Check the completed reasoning note within s6

incremental.description: Maintain source-index rules and test pack completeness

approvals.approved_version: s6 accepted assessment reasoning note version and target pupil/case identifier

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 assembly + 3 commit hours minus 1 upkeep = 17. Low covers half the assembly and retains manual commit: 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5. Diagnosis, eligibility, clarification and all note writing retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce evidence assembly and documentation effort around safeguarding and assessment while protecting the psychologist's professional decisions.
reach: Help school counsellors prepare traceable evidence chronologies within access limits.
role.ambitious_version: A psychologist with clearer evidence trails and more time for careful interpretation and family discussion.
